parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT followup_id FROM wf_call_followups
     WHERE RIGHT(phone, 10) = RIGHT('{{ $json.phone }}', 10)
       AND (recording_synced IS NULL OR recording_synced = 0)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS followup_id,
  (SELECT lead_id FROM wf_call_followups
     WHERE RIGHT(phone, 10) = RIGHT('{{ $json.phone }}', 10)
       AND (recording_synced IS NULL OR recording_synced = 0)
     ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS lead_id;
UPDATE wf_call_followups SET recording_synced = 1 WHERE followup_id = '{{ $json.followup_id }}';
